name: mem0
notes: Baseline measured with cwd=$SRC=eval/work/base/<name> under a clean env (env -i HOME/PATH/LANG + test_env, RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY unset, no provider API keys) with outbound network denied via macOS sandbox-exec (loopback + unix sockets allowed); counts were identical on a from-scratch rebuild into eval/work/envs/<name>-check (since deleted). Mirrors CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml build_mem0: pip install -e '.[test,graph,vector_stores,llms,extras]' then `make test` -> `hatch run test` -> pytest tests/). 'graph' is not a defined extra in pyproject (pip ignores it) so it is omitted; 'vector_stores' is spelled 'vector-stores'. Python 3.12 (CI matrix 3.10-3.12). Deviation from CI: `anthropic` is installed additionally so tests/llms/test_anthropic.py (25 mocked tests of the Anthropic LLM provider, a migration-relevant call site) runs instead of importorskip-ing; CI skips it. --exclude-newer 2026-10-13 pins dependency resolution to a fixed date for reproducibility. No deselections: service-dependent tests skip themselves the same way they do in CI (74 skips): Milvus/Redis Stack/Valkey/pgvector not reachable on localhost, S3_VECTORS_BUCKET/SUPABASE_CONN_STRING/Azure/Oracle credentials unset, RUN_TEST_NEPTUNE_ANALYTICS unset, turbopuffer not installed, spaCy en_core_web_sm model missing, and server tests (test_api_keys_router/test_server_auth/test_server_params) importorskip fastapi (server/requirements.txt not installed, as in CI). Do NOT set MEM0_TELEMETRY=False: 9 tests in tests/test_oss_to_platform_migrate.py and tests/memory/test_notices.py assert telemetry events and fail with it disabled. Telemetry (posthog) will try to reach the network if the harness does not block it; with network blocked it fails silently and tests pass. HF_HUB_OFFLINE/TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE keep sentence-transformers/HF from downloading. Editable install points at $SRC; tests also import from cwd via pyproject pythonpath=['.']. Rebuild takes ~6s with a warm .tools/uv-cache (torch, transformers etc. are large on a cold cache).
